name: swarm-manager-quality-gates
title: Swarm Manager Quality Gates And Self-Correction
description: Address structural gaps in swarm-manager's planning-to-execution pipeline that cause drift between what was planned and what gets built. Three interconnected improvements: (1) programmatic validation gates on plan.md content during workshop finalization to catch missing sections, skills, and template usage before execution begins, (2) meta-orchestration as a first-class swarm-manager feature with persistent conversations, initiative/item attribution, and resume capability, (3) research into initiative-level oversight agents that validate cross-item coherence and detect drift from original planning intent. Motivated by real drift observed during vrooli-events initiative execution where agents created scenarios without using templates, omitted UIs, and produced PRDs misaligned with planning decisions.
